query: I have a 73-year-old male inpatient with intracranial hemorrhage transferred from ICU. For male patients aged 68–78 with ICH post‑ICU, report cohort size, 30‑day mortality, AKI and ARDS rates, composite risk score 25/50/75th percentiles, and median survival among decedents.
